items.summary: Recommendation: preserve the active Great American Lakes and SEO measurement work, and queue bounded report-only baselines for xxxtea.com, marineactivity.com, and aliencouncil.com. Evidence: the 30-day SEO window shows 87 shared impressions across five xxxtea pages, 239 impressions at position 8.3 for marineactivity.com, and 77 impressions at position 5.5 for aliencouncil.com. Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21, but site-level margin and ROI are not calculable because attribution is incomplete and one tracking ID is unmapped. The main unknown is whether each opportunity can improve qualified clicks or conversions without harming existing rankings. Smallest next step: capture baselines and return one reversible recommendation per site, with a 14-day or 100-impression measurement gate and rollback criteria. Owner question: should SearchWoot remain private, or should I prepare a bounded owner-approved request for Woot commercial/public-display permission?
